title: A new terminal opened the moment the app answers, then typed into at once: it shows, in the one window, and takes the keys
why: A person (or a script) opens a new terminal right after launch, while the app is still connecting to cmux-tui, and types at once. On v2.2.2 and v2.2.3 the workspace was made by the daemon but went to a second window (the launch window was not registered yet), the launch window stayed on Home, and the typed keys went to the Chief composer and were sent to Chief as a message (dogfood gate v2.2.3, journey type on cmux17). new_terminal here is the person's New Terminal Tab key (Ctrl-`, debug.key, origin user), pressed with no wait for the connection: the driver's first act after the app's socket answers (pressed again while the app has no window yet). A script's newTab no longer takes the person's keyboard (cp/fix-chief-composer-focus); scripted-newtab-keeps-person-keys covers that.
source: dogfood gate v2.2.3 (cp/fix-newtab-at-launch): type failed 1 in N on fresh apps

steps.title: the command ran in the new terminal, shown and focused in the app's only window
